_comment: Dresses the garage (docs/modding.md, props): its model, made by tools/GarageScene/build_props.py from Poly Haven's spray_paint_bottles (CC0), drawn at each of its places in a garage, by the garage's folder name. A place is a position [x, y, z] in metres from the car's spot (+x the car's left, +z its nose, y up from the floor), a heading in degrees about the vertical, and for a prop laid down or leant against a wall a tilt (tipped forward) and a roll (over to its side): the game stands it back on its base.
name: Spray cans
credit: "Spray Paint Bottles" by James Ray Cock, Poly Haven (CC0)
